title: Observability: KEY_IMPORT/KEY_GENERATE/DO_KDF FIPS gate failure omits raw status code
description: In fd.c, ioctl_key_import, ioctl_key_generate, and ioctl_do_kdf all call ops->fips_gate() and on failure log a message that omits the raw return value from fips_gate(). Examples: 'KEY_IMPORT: FIPS not operational' and 'KEY_GENERATE: FIPS not operational' and 'DO_KDF: FIPS not operational' — none include the fips_gate() return code. Compare with ioctl_init which correctly logs fips_ret: 'init: FIPS gate rejected — provider not operational (%d)'. Without the raw code a support engineer cannot distinguish a wolfCrypt status code (e.g., FIPS_DEGRADED_E=-152, FIPS_NOT_ALLOWED_E=-181) without attaching a debugger. Fix: capture and log fips_ret in all three callsites, matching the ioctl_init pattern.
